(def derive
  "Establishes a parent/child relationship between parent and
  tag. Parent must be a namespace-qualified symbol or keyword and
  child can be either a namespace-qualified symbol or keyword or a
  type. h must be a hierarchy obtained from make-hierarchy, if not
  supplied defaults to, and modifies, the global hierarchy."
  (fn
    ([tag parent]
     (when-not (namespace parent)
       (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (namespace parent)")))
     (when-not (or (suss.bootstrap/type-constructor? tag) (and (implements? INamed tag) (namespace tag)))
       (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (or (class? tag) (and (instance? clojure.lang.Named tag) (namespace tag)))")))
     (swap-global-hierarchy! derive tag parent) nil)
    ([h tag parent]
     (when-not (not= tag parent)
       (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (not= tag parent)")))
     (when-not (or (suss.bootstrap/type-constructor? tag) (implements? INamed tag))
       (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (or (class? tag) (instance? clojure.lang.Named tag))")))
     (when-not (implements? INamed parent)
       (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (instance? clojure.lang.Named parent)")))
     (let [tp (:parents h)
           td (:descendants h)
           ta (:ancestors h)
           tf (fn [m source sources target targets]
                (reduce (fn [ret k]
                          (assoc ret k
                                 (reduce conj (get targets k #{}) (cons target (targets target)))))
                        m (cons source (sources source))))]
       (or
        (when-not (contains? (tp tag) parent)
          (when (contains? (ta tag) parent)
            (throw (suss.bootstrap/error (print-str tag "already has" parent "as ancestor"))))
          (when (contains? (ta parent) tag)
            (throw (suss.bootstrap/error (print-str "Cyclic derivation:" parent "has" tag "as ancestor"))))
          {:parents (assoc (:parents h) tag (conj (get tp tag #{}) parent))
           :ancestors (tf (:ancestors h) tag td parent ta)
           :descendants (tf (:descendants h) parent ta tag td)})
        h)))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Follows Clojure: each assert throws "Assert failed: <form>" with Clojure's form text, a type (Clojure's class) may be a tag, and the ancestor and cycle errors are built with print-str, so their words are separated by spaces where ClojureScript's str_ joins them.
